7045-marching-men.title: Marching Men
7045-marching-men.creator: Sherwood Anderson
7045-marching-men.description: A book by Sherwood Anderson. It was an ill day for births in Coal Creek, even for the birth of one of Uncle Charlie's inspirations. Snow lay piled along the sidewalks and in the gutters of Main Street--black snow, sordid with the gathered grime of human endeavour that went on day and night in the bowels of the hills. Through the soiled snow walked miners, stumbling along silently and with blackened faces.

arxiv-1906-08667.title: A network approach to cartel detection in public auction markets
arxiv-1906-08667.creator: Johannes Wachs, János Kertész
arxiv-1906-08667.description: Abstract Competing firms can increase profits by setting prices collectively, imposing significant costs on consumers. Such groups of firms are known as cartels and because this behavior is illegal, their operations are secretive and difficult to detect. Cartels feel a significant internal obstacle: members feel short-run incentives to cheat.

arxiv-1908-04193.title: Identifying and characterizing ZMap scans: a cryptanalytic approach
arxiv-1908-04193.creator: Johan Mazel, Rémi Strullu
arxiv-1908-04193.description: Abstract Network scanning tools play a major role in Internet security. They are used by both network security researchers and malicious actors to identify vulnerable machines exposed on the Internet. ZMap is one of the most common probing tools for high-speed Internet-wide scanning. We present novel identification methods based on the IPv4 iteration process of ZMap.

arxiv-2109-00478.title: Doping controlled Fano resonance in bilayer 1T ′ -ReS 2 : Raman experiments and first-principles theoretical analysis
arxiv-2109-00478.creator: Subhadip Das 1 , Suchitra Prasad 2 , Biswanath Chakraborty 1,3 , Bhakti Jariwala 4 , Sai Shradha 4 , D. V. S. Muthu 1 , Arnab Bhattacharya 4 , U. V. Waghmare 2 and A. K. Sood 1
arxiv-2109-00478.description: Abstract In the bilayer ReS 2 channel of a field-effect transistor (FET), we demonstrate using Raman spectroscopy that electron doping (n) results in softening of frequency and broadening of linewidth of the in-plane vibrational modes, leaving out-of-plane vibrational modes unaffected.

arxiv-2307-14259.title: Beating resonance patterns and extreme power flux skewing in anisotropic elastic plates
arxiv-2307-14259.creator: Daniel A. Kiefer, Sylvain Mezil, Claire PradaInstitut Langevin, ESPCI Paris, Université PSL, CNRS, 75005 Paris, France
arxiv-2307-14259.description: Abstract Elastic waves in anisotropic media can exhibit a power flux that is not collinear with the wave vector. This has notable consequences for waves guided in a plate. Through laser-ultrasonic experiments, we evidence remarkable phenomena due to slow waves in a single crystal silicon wafer. Waves exhibiting power flux orthogonal to their wave vector are identified.

arxiv-2402-07824.title: Uranus’s influence on Neptune’s exterior mean motion resonances Facilities: ADS rebound
arxiv-2402-07824.creator: Severance Graham, Kathryn Volk
arxiv-2402-07824.description: Abstract Neptune’s external mean motion resonances play an important role in sculpting the observed population of transneptunian objects (TNOs). The population of scattering TNOs are known to ‘stick’ to Neptune’s resonances while evolving in semimajor axis ( a a ), though simulations show that resonance sticking is less prevalent at a ≳ 200 − 250 a\gtrsim 200-250 au.

arxiv-2404-05802.title: BatSort: Enhanced Battery Classification with Transfer Learning for Battery Sorting and Recycling Thanks: This work was supported in part by A*STAR under its MTC Programmatic (Award M23L9b0052), MTC Individual Research Grants (IRG) (Award M23M6c0113), the Ministry of Education, Singapore, under the
arxiv-2404-05802.creator: Yunyi Zhao, Wei Zhang ∗, Erhai Hu, Qingyu Yan, Cheng Xiang, King Jet Tseng, Dusit Niyato
arxiv-2404-05802.description: Abstract Battery recycling is a critical process for minimizing environmental harm and resource waste for used batteries. However, it is challenging, largely because sorting batteries is costly and hardly automated to group batteries based on battery types. In this paper, we introduce a machine learning-based approach for battery-type classification and address the daunting problem of data scarcity for the application.

arxiv-2506-20251.title: Q-resafe: Assessing Safety Risks and Quantization-aware Safety Patching for Quantized Large Language Models
arxiv-2506-20251.creator: Kejia Chen, Jiawen Zhang, Jiacong Hu, Yu Wang, Jian Lou, Zunlei Feng, Mingli Song
arxiv-2506-20251.description: Abstract Quantized large language models (LLMs) have gained increasing attention and significance for enabling deployment in resource-constrained environments. However, emerging studies on a few calibration dataset-free quantization methods suggest that quantization may compromise the safety capabilities of LLMs, underscoring the urgent need for systematic safety evaluations and effective mitigation strategies.

europmc-pmc4861754.title: Adipose tissue plasticity: how fat depots respond differently to pathophysiological cues.
europmc-pmc4861754.creator: Pellegrinelli V, Carobbio S, Vidal-Puig A.
europmc-pmc4861754.description: White adipose tissue (WAT) has key metabolic and endocrine functions and plays a role in regulating energy homeostasis and insulin sensitivity. WAT is characterised by its capacity to adapt and expand in response to surplus energy through processes of adipocyte hypertrophy...

pmc-10568714.title: Preparation of N-Linked-Type GlcNAc Monomers for Glycopolymers and Binding Specificity for Lectin
pmc-10568714.creator: Takahiko Matsushita, Momoka Nozaki, Mio Sunaga, Tetsuo Koyama, Ken Hatano, Koji Matsuoka
pmc-10568714.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Glycomonomers having N-glycosidic linkages were prepared from a known glycosyl amine, N-acetyl-d-glucosamine (GlcNAc). Radical polymerization of the glycomonomers gave a series of glycopolymers displaying various sugar densities, which were models of the core structure of Asn-linked-type glycoproteins. In addition, fluorometric analyses of wheat germ agglutinin (WGA) against the glycopolymers were carried out, and the results showed unique binding specificities on the basis of flexibility of sugar moieties.

pmc-11452623.title: The G4 resolvase Dhx36 modulates cardiomyocyte differentiation and ventricular conduction system development
pmc-11452623.creator: Pablo Gómez-del Arco, Joan Isern, Daniel Jimenez-Carretero, Dolores López-Maderuelo, Rebeca Piñeiro-Sabarís, Fadoua El Abdellaoui-Soussi, Carlos Torroja, María Linarejos Vera-Pedrosa, Mercedes Grima-Terrén, Alberto Benguria, Ana Simón-Chica, Antonio Queiro-Palou, Ana Dopazo, Fátima Sánchez-Cabo, Jos
pmc-11452623.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Extensive genetic studies have elucidated cardiomyocyte differentiation and associated gene networks using single-cell RNA-seq, yet the intricate transcriptional mechanisms governing cardiac conduction system (CCS) development and working cardiomyocyte differentiation remain largely unexplored. Here we show that mice deleted for Dhx36 (encoding the Dhx36 helicase) in the embryonic or neonatal heart develop overt dilated cardiomyopathy, surface ECG alterations related to cardiac impulse propagation, and (in the embryonic heart) a lack of a ventricular conduction system (VCS).

pmc-11641452.title: Associations Between Retinal Vascular Occlusions and Dementia
pmc-11641452.creator: Minali Prasad, Deniz Goodman, Sanhit Gutta, Zahra Sheikh, Howard J Cabral, Jenny Shunyakova, Nayan Sanjiv, Cameron Curley, Rohun Reddy Yarala, Lynna Tsai, Nicole H Siegel, Xuejing Chen, Vasiliki Poulaki, Michael L Alosco, Thor D Stein, Steven Ness, Manju L Subramanian, Andrzej Grzybowski
pmc-11641452.description: Background/Objectives: Retinal vascular occlusions, such as retinal vein occlusion (RVO) and retinal artery occlusion (RAO), are associated with cognitive impairment, including dementia. Our objective was to examine the odds of dementia among patients with retinal vascular occlusion. Methods: This cross-sectional study included 474 patients with retinal vascular occlusion and 948 patients without retinal vascular occlusion (comparison group).

pmc-12513101.title: Polymerase theta inhibition impairs tumor growth and amplifies melphalan-induced DNA damage in multiple myeloma
pmc-12513101.creator: Qun Li, Chi Ma, Liping Zuo, Aoshuang Xu, Bo Zhang, Fei Zhao, Lifei Liu, Xin Zhao, Yu Hu, Chunyan Sun
pmc-12513101.description: BackgroundThe dysregulation of the DNA damage response (DDR) plays a vital role in cancer development and inadequate response to anti-cancer therapy. We investigated the involvement of DNA polymerase theta (Polθ), the principal component of the microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ) pathway, in the pathogenesis of multiple myeloma (MM).

pmc-12643530.title: Cytokinin‐responsive P‐type cyclins control Arabidopsis radial style morphology
pmc-12643530.creator: Iqra Jamil, Samuel W. H. Koh, Jitender Cheema, Laila Moubayidin
pmc-12643530.description: SUMMARYThe biological mechanisms responsible for correct shape acquisition at the apex of the female reproductive organ, the gynoecium, remain poorly understood, despite its fundamental importance for successful plant reproduction and seed production. This process involves a rare bilateral‐to‐radial symmetry transition in Arabidopsis thaliana, orchestrated in part by the transcription factor SPATULA (SPT).

pmc-12994188.title: Opioid-specific brain connectivity dynamics distinguish analgesia from secondary effects: Studies in male mice
pmc-12994188.creator: Jean-Charles Mariani, Samuel Le Meur-Diebolt, Laurianne Beynac, Renata Santos, Stefan Schulz, Thomas Deffieux, Mickael Tanter, Zsolt Lenkei, Andrea Kliewer
pmc-12994188.description: SignificanceThis study elucidates large-scale neural circuit dynamics underlying opioid-induced effects using functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) in awake, behaving male mice. By mapping functional connectivity (FC) changes following administration of morphine, fentanyl, methadone, and buprenorphine, we identify an opioid-specific FC fingerprint that scales with µ-opioid receptor (MOP) agonist efficacy.

pmc-13063874.title: The role of filial piety and family dysfunction in eating pathology: a cross-sectional and longitudinal study within the Chinese context
pmc-13063874.creator: Xu Han, Mei-chun Cheung, Xueni Li, Lei Yang, Chao Chen
pmc-13063874.description: BackgroundFamily functioning encompasses cultural values and behavioral patterns, with family dysfunction referring to pervasive and maladaptive interactions in the latter dimension. In Chinese culture, filial piety is a core familial value, comprising authoritarian filial piety (AFP), rooted in hierarchy and obedience, and reciprocal filial piety (RFP), based on mutual affection and care.

pmc-13098133.title: Intraoperative Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound Versus Traditional Intraoperative Ultrasound for Detecting Lung Nodules During Robotic-assisted Thoracic Surgery
pmc-13098133.creator: Gaetana Messina, Giuseppe Vicario, Vincenzo Di Filippo, Davide Gerardo Pica, Beatrice Leonardi, Noemi Maria Giorgiano, Angela Iovine, Riccardo Vinciguerra, Francesca Capasso, Paolo Chiodini, Annafrancesca Smimmo, Giovanni Vicidomini, Alfonso Fiorelli

pmc-13147101.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1829 THROMBECTOMY BENEFITS ARE UNCERTAIN IN PATIENTS WITH ISCHEMIC STROKE, PRE-MORBID DISABILITY AND LARGE VESSEL OCCLUSION - A METAANALYSIS
pmc-13147101.creator: Jason Vuong, Shaloo Singhal, Michael Valente, Angelos Sharobeam, Lubna Shakhatreh, Andy Lim, Peter Mitchell, Bernard Yan, Henry MA, Thanh Phan
pmc-13147101.description: Background and aimsMultiple randomized control trials have shown that thrombectomy for ischemic stroke resulting from large vessel occlusion (LVO) reduces disability and is cost effective. There remains uncertainty whether thrombectomy for patients with pre-stroke disability (modified Rankin Score/mRS3-4) is similarly effective, as prior meta-analysis (n=14) included cases of mRS2 among those classified as pre-stroke disability.

pmc-13257215.title: Effects of Commercial Exergames vs. Traditional Indoor Exercise on Mood in Older Adults: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13257215.creator: Yingying Zhu, Xuanjia Ren, Jinho Yim, Yunxue Guan
pmc-13257215.description: Background/Objectives: With the development of the silver economy, older adults have shown increasing interest in digital technologies, such as electronic fitness games (Exergames). This study explores the impact of commercial exergames on the emotional experience of older adults in order to provide novel ideas and applications for healthy aging.

pmc-13363170.title: Healthier Macronutrient Profiles but Higher Risk of Specific Micronutrient Deficiencies: A Cross-Sectional Study of Vegans, Lacto-Ovo-Vegetarians and Omnivores in Northeast China
pmc-13363170.creator: Xin Liu, Ang Li, Miaoyu An, Hongyan Wu, Huan Wang, Changbao Sun

pmc-13437747.title: Subtype-Specific Alterations in Copper Trafficking Associated with KRAS Mutations in Isogenic Colorectal Cancer Cell Lines
pmc-13437747.creator: Elina Üveges, Anikó Gaál, Gergely Szakács, Éva Bakos, Christina Streli, Peter Kregsamer, Marcell Baranyi, Balázs Hegedűs, Norbert Szoboszlai
pmc-13437747.description: Copper bioavailability has been identified as a potential target for KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer, a disease for which treatment options remain limited. Therefore, we investigated copper homeostasis in isogeneic colorectal cancer cell models carrying distinct KRAS codon 12 mutations (G12C, G12D and G12V).

pmc-13657624.title: Assessment of chemotherapy-associated sarcopenia using SARC-F and handgrip strength: a cross-sectional analysis
pmc-13657624.creator: Nabil Almouaalamy
pmc-13657624.description: Background:Sarcopenia is a significant health concern among patients with cancer who receive chemotherapy due to its potential impacts on treatment tolerance and functional status.Objectives:To explore the association between chemotherapeutic agents and practical sarcopenia markers, including SARC-F scores and grip strength, among oncology outpatients with advanced cancer, and to explore the relationship between chemotherapy exposure (cycle number) and functional muscle decline.

uslaw-usc-t48-s1755.title: 48 U.S.C. § 1755 — Compensation, privileges, and immunities
uslaw-usc-t48-s1755.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s1755.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 16 (Delegates To Congress); Subchapter III (Northern Mariana Islands Delegate). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Until the Rules of the House of Representatives are amended to provide otherwise, the Delegate from the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands shall receive the same compensation, allowances, and benefits as a Member of the House.
